name: 國民身分證統一編號 (National Identification Card number)
issuer: the household registration office (戶政事務所)
note: The Ministry of the Interior's rules on the national identification card and household certificate (國民身分證及戶口名簿格式內容製發相片影像檔建置管理辦法, as amended 18 October 2024) and the Household Registration Act (戶籍法, as amended 21 January 2015), both on the Ministry of Justice's law database, read 2026-10-30: the Act has the household registration office assign the number by the method the central authority sets (art. 55); the rules (art. 3, 4) make it ten characters, a letter for the municipality or county followed by nine digits, the second a sex code and the tenth a check digit (its rule isn't given, `check` left out), one number to a person, assigned at birth registration and at first household registration. Read as given at birth, to citizens (國民; those first registering later get it then, not modelled). No fee or time is stated for the number itself.

sources.title: 全國法規資料庫, 國民身分證及戶口名簿格式內容製發相片影像檔建置管理辦法
sources.said: 國民身分證統一編號（以下簡稱統一編號）由文字碼及數字碼組成，共計十碼，一人配賦一號。 ... 前項編號首碼以英文字母代表直轄市、縣（市）別，第二碼至第十碼為數字碼，第二碼為性別碼，第十碼為檢查碼。 ... 戶政事務所辦理出生登記及初設戶籍登記，應配賦統一編號。

sources.title: 全國法規資料庫, 戶籍法
sources.said: 國民身分證統一編號與戶口名簿戶號之編定及配賦方式，由中央主管機關定之，交由戶政事務所配賦。
